title: Quiz: Data Types
description: Check your understanding of Data Types.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in C#?
questions.explanation: In C#, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Which of these is typically a boolean value?
questions.explanation: Booleans represent truth values — only two states.

questions.question: True or False: In most languages, "42" (with quotes) and 42 (without quotes) are the same value.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: price = 9;
questions.explanation: Statements are terminated the way the language requires.

questions.question: In C#, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
